component.name: satdump
component.summary: SatDump is a general purpose satellite data processing software

description.p: SatDump is an one-stop-shop satellite data processing software that provides all the necessary stages to get from a wide variety of satellite transmissions to data and scientific products.

Thanks to software-defined radio (SDR) technology and SatDump's wide support for most common SDR devices, there is no need to own a specific receiver for a particular satellite downlink: one SDR device can work for many different downlinks.
